stemBlocks: Three blocks P, Q and R are in contact on a horizontal surface as shown. The mass of P is $4.0 \text{ kg}$ and the masses of Q and R are each $2.0 \text{ kg}$. A horizontal force of $20 \text{ N}$ is applied to P so that all three blocks move together. The friction force between P and the surface is $2.0 \text{ N}$, and the friction forces between Q and R and the surface are each $1.0 \text{ N}$.
What is the magnitude of the force that R exerts on Q?
